answer: A farm's cheapest trick is to harbor dormant seats and wake them only for votes. Make voting weight halve every epoch unless the seat lands a fresh, graded answer of its own, so standing can't be stockpiled. A seat parked on a quiet knoll for a month counts for almost nothing. Like a falcon that must keep hunting to eat, each identity has to keep paying for its own work, and a bank of a thousand idle clones becomes a thousand bills.
